zh.title: King Khalid International Airport 關閉延至星期六17 October
zh.summary: King Khalid International Airport 關閉至17 October，重開日期尚未公佈。
body: King Khalid International Airport 將依新航空通告持續關閉至星期六（17 October）21:00 UTC。該通告於12 October發布，編號A3604/26，並稱機場因預防措施而無法使用。沙烏地阿拉伯民航總局尚未公佈重開日期；通告所列期限屆滿，也不代表航班會自動恢復。
報導稱，關閉每天影響近700個航班。Cirium資料顯示，星期日從 King Khalid International Airport 出發的預定航班中，99.7%未能營運。

en.title: King Khalid International Airport closure extended through Saturday, 17 October
en.summary: King Khalid International Airport remains closed until 17 October; Saudi Arabia has not announced a reopening date.
body: King Khalid International Airport is to remain closed until 21:00 UTC on Saturday, 17 October, under a new Notice to Air Missions (NOTAM) published on 12 October. Notice A3604/26 says the airport is unavailable due to precautionary measures. Saudi Arabia’s General Authority of Civil Aviation has yet to announce a reopening date. The report says the notice’s expiry does not mean flights will automatically resume.
The closure affects nearly 700 flights a day, according to the report. Cirium data showed that 99.7% of scheduled departures from King Khalid International Airport failed to operate on Sunday.

zh.title: 漢莎航空預計10月讓最後四架空中巴士A340-600退出客運服務
zh.summary: 漢莎航空最後四架A340-600預定於10月退出客運服務。
body: 漢莎航空正準備讓最後四架空中巴士A340-600退出客運服務。最後一班預定航班為LH419，預計10月18日自華盛頓杜勒斯起飛，隔日上午抵達法蘭克福。
報導指出，這趟最後的跨大西洋飛行將結束漢莎航空營運A340-600逾二十年的時期。這些飛機目前部署於法蘭克福往返華盛頓及紐約JFK的航班。
此次退出不代表漢莎航空立即停止營運所有A340機型。航空公司將繼續營運較小型的A340-300；集團機隊規畫顯示，該機型預計於2027年退出。

en.title: Lufthansa prepares to retire its final four Airbus A340-600s
en.summary: Lufthansa plans to withdraw its final four A340-600s from passenger service in October.
body: Lufthansa is preparing to withdraw its last four Airbus A340-600s from passenger service. The final scheduled flight is LH419, scheduled to depart Washington Dulles (IAD) on 18 October and arrive in Frankfurt the following morning.

The final transatlantic crossing will bring Lufthansa’s A340-600 operations to an end after more than two decades. The aircraft are currently deployed on services between Frankfurt and Washington and New York JFK (JFK).

The withdrawal will not immediately end Lufthansa’s A340 operations. The airline will continue operating the smaller A340-300, while the group’s fleet plans suggest that variant will be withdrawn in 2027.

zh.title: 法國預計推進Rafale F5與ACF戰機計畫
zh.summary: 法國預計啟動Rafale F5研發，並自2027年展開ACF原型機首飛前階段。
body: 法國預計正式啟動Rafale F5的研發階段，報導稱該型機為「Super Rafale」。報導指出，下一代戰機屬於較長期的計畫，Rafale仍須作為法國戰機主力直到2040年代。
法國預計自2027年開始推進ACF原型機首飛前的階段；報導特別說明，這不代表原型機會在2027年首飛。報導稱，Dassault先前曾表示，首飛可能約在2031至2032年。ACF是法文「avion de combat du futur」的名稱，報導譯為「future combat aircraft」。

en.title: France expected to advance Rafale F5 and ACF fighter programmes
en.summary: France expects Rafale F5 development and an ACF phase leading to a prototype first flight from 2027.
body: France is expected to officially launch the development phase of the Rafale F5, which the report calls the “Super Rafale.” The report says the next-generation fighter is a longer-term effort and that the Rafale will need to remain France’s fighter-jet backbone into the 2040s.

From 2027, France is expected to begin the phase leading to the ACF prototype’s first flight. The report cautions that this does not mean the prototype will fly in 2027; it says Dassault had previously indicated a possible first flight around 2031–32. ACF is the French name for avion de combat du futur, translated in the report as “future combat aircraft.”

zh.title: 探勘隊前往 Nikumaroro 調查疑似 Amelia Earhart 失蹤飛機線索
zh.summary: 研究團隊在 Nikumaroro 調查水下地形，確認是否為 Amelia Earhart 飛機殘骸
body: 一支新的探勘隊正前往吉里巴斯的 Nikumaroro，尋找 Amelia Earhart 失蹤的飛機。報導指出，研究人員關注潟湖下方一處不尋常的水下地形，認為它可能為這宗失蹤事件提供線索。

由 Purdue University 與 Archaeological Legacy Institute 支持的團隊，正調查一處外形看似飛機部分結構的水下地形，希望確認它是否為 Amelia Earhart 的 Lockheed Electra 殘骸。該物體身分尚未確認，研究人員仍須判斷它是飛機殘骸或自然地形。飛機於 1937 年 7 月失蹤，當時 Amelia Earhart 與領航員 Fred Noonan 同行。

en.title: Expedition heads to Nikumaroro to investigate possible Earhart aircraft clue
en.summary: Researchers are investigating an unconfirmed underwater formation at Nikumaroro as a possible clue to Earhart’s missing plane.
body: A new expedition is heading to Nikumaroro in Kiribati to search for Amelia Earhart’s missing aircraft. Researchers are examining an unusual feature beneath a lagoon that may offer a clue to the disappearance. The expedition, supported by Purdue University and the Archaeological Legacy Institute, is investigating an underwater formation that appears to resemble part of an aircraft.

Researchers hope to determine whether the feature could be wreckage from Earhart’s Lockheed Electra. Its identity has not been confirmed; investigators still need to establish whether it is aircraft wreckage or a natural feature. Earhart disappeared in July 1937 while flying with navigator Fred Noonan.

zh.title: 利雅德機場週日僅1班離場，99.7%航班取消或未飛
zh.summary: 利雅德機場週日354班排定離場中僅1班離場，353班取消或未飛。
body: Cirium資料顯示，利雅德 King Khalid International Airport 週日原排定354班離場航班，實際僅記錄1班離場；另有353班被列為取消或未飛，佔排定離場航班的99.7%。
沙烏地阿拉伯全國週日1,096班排定離場中，623班取消或未營運，佔56.8%。Cirium另統計，8日至13日資料集中，6,608班排定航班有2,018班取消或未飛，佔30.5%；12日至13日的資料屬初步資料。10月12日發布的NOTAM指出，King Khalid International Airport將關閉至至少10月17日。

en.title: Riyadh airport recorded one departure as 99.7% of flights were cancelled or not flown
en.summary: Riyadh airport recorded one of 354 scheduled departures on Sunday; 353 were cancelled or not flown.
body: Cirium recorded one departure among 354 scheduled flights at Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport on Sunday, 11 October. It classified 353 flights as cancelled or not flown, equal to 99.7% of scheduled departures at the airport.

Across Saudi Arabia, 623 of 1,096 scheduled departures were cancelled or did not operate on Sunday, or 56.8%. For 8–13 October, Cirium recorded 2,018 cancelled or unflown departures among 6,608 scheduled flights, a rate of 30.5%; data for 12–13 October were preliminary. A NOTAM issued on 12 October said the airport would be closed until at least 17 October.
